04/How it works

It knows why it contacted them, and what it refused to send you.

It finds them

It watches for the moment a business needs you, then writes the one message that says so.

→they have already decided to spend the money

→budget exists and nobody has claimed it yet
04

Nothing is sent until you have read it.

Checked against

It does the work

The work is checked against itself before you ever see it, let alone your client.

A finding with nothing to do about it
heldnaming the finding that carries no recommendation

heldthe number and the caveat cannot both stand

You get finished work or an honest reason. Never a confident guess.

05/The product

Not a chat window. Your whole business, running.

Scroll through it. Each screen is a real business at work — the client work first, then finding the next client.

01/Home

It has already worked out what to do next.

Ranked by money, deadline and silence — every row showing the arithmetic that put it there.

02/Invoices

Every figure is the one the chaser reads.

Five invoices, two overdue, the oldest at 34 days. Nothing here was typed into a task.

03/Requests

It knows what it is waiting on, and from whom.

The work really is stopped until they answer, so the count is about your business.

04/Clock

It runs on a clock, not on you remembering.

Pause anything and the business stops doing that thing. It never fails silently.

05/Brain

Ask the business anything.

Every answer comes back labelled with the record it came from.

06/Knowledge

Tell it once. It holds the judgment.

Your own words, underneath — the text every job from here on is grounded on.

07/Deliverables

The work, rendered — not a filename in a list.

A real spreadsheet, opened in the inspector. Every figure is the one the client receives.

08/Client portal

Their side of it, on your name.

A different session, a different sign-in. This is the page your client actually opens.

09/Pipeline

A pipeline that fills itself in.

Everyone it is working, at the stage they actually reached, with the next touch to the minute.

Every frame above is the running product on a demo business.

Talk to us

Mycel is invite-only for now, while it is being shaped around its first customers. Request access and we will talk about whether it fits what you run — if it does, your account opens on a seven-day trial at the plan's full limits, and nothing is charged inside those seven days. Self-hosting is free forever and needs no invite.

A job is one run of your business: an inbound message answered, a scheduled sync, a document processed.

We buy the AI tokens. Starter includes 1× delivery capacity; Growth includes 5×. If you burn through a month's headroom, new runs pause until the month turns over or you move up a plan — never a surprise overage bill. Self-host and you bring your own key, so nothing is metered at all.

Or run the same code yourself, on your own servers, with your own model key. Apache-2.0, nothing metered.
